008package paint.viewer.override.recording_override;
009
010import paint.shared.utils.TextFiles;
011import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
012import paint.viewer.model.SquareControlParams;
013import paint.viewer.model.RecordingEntry;
014
015import java.io.IOException;
016import java.nio.file.*;
017import java.time.LocalDateTime;
018import java.util.*;
019
020import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
021
022/**
023 * Handles persistence of per-recording filter overrides in the PAINT Viewer.
024 * <p>
025 * Overrides are stored in:
026 * <pre>
027 *     Viewer/Recording Override.csv
028 * </pre>
029 * Each entry maps a {@code (experimentName, recordingName)} pair to a set of
030 * filter threshold values chosen by the user. This enables restoring these
031 * thresholds between Viewer sessions and applying batch updates across scopes.
032 */
033public class WriteRecordingOverride {
034
035    /** Path to: Viewer/Recording Override.csv */
036    private final Path csvFilePath;
037
038    /**
039     * Column headers for the CSV (must match the reader expectations elsewhere).
040     * The file is considered invalid if the header does not match, and will be
041     * rebuilt from scratch on the next write.
042     */
043    private static final String[] HEADER = {
044            EXPERIMENT_NAME,
045            RECORDING_NAME,
046            TIME_STAMP,
047            MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO,
048            MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY,
049            MIN_REQUIRED_R_SQUARED,
050            NEIGHBOUR_MODE
051    };
052
053    /**
054     * Builds the composite key used for identifying override rows.
055     *
056     * @param exp experiment name
057     * @param rec recording name
058     * @return composite key: {@code exp + "§" + rec}
059     */
060    private static String key(String exp, String rec) {
061        return exp + "§" + rec;
062    }
063
064    /**
065     * Creates a new writer and ensures the {@code Viewer/} folder exists.
066     *
067     * @param projectPath root of the PAINT project
068     */
069    public WriteRecordingOverride(Path projectPath) {
070        Path viewerPath = projectPath.resolve("Viewer");
071
072        try {
073            Files.createDirectories(viewerPath);
074        } catch (IOException e) {
075            PaintLogger.warnf("Failed to create Viewer directory: %s", e.getMessage());
076        }
077
078        this.csvFilePath = viewerPath.resolve("Recording Override.csv");
079    }
080
081    /**
082     * Applies and writes overrides for the selected scope:
083     *
084     * <ul>
085     *   <li>{@code "Recording"}  – update only the current recording</li>
086     *   <li>{@code "Experiment"} – update all recordings in the same experiment</li>
087     *   <li>{@code "Project"}    – update every recording in the viewer</li>
088     * </ul>
089     *
090     * Overrides are written non-destructively: existing rows for the same
091     * {@code (experimentName, recordingName)} pair are replaced; all other entries
092     * are preserved.
093     *
094     * @param scope            one of: "Recording", "Experiment", "Project"
095     * @param params           current UI threshold parameters to persist
096     * @param recordingEntries all loaded recording entries in the viewer
097     * @param currentIndex     index of the currently selected recording entry
098     */
099    public void writeRecordingOverridesToFile(
100            String scope,
101            SquareControlParams params,
102            List<RecordingEntry> recordingEntries,
103            int currentIndex
104    ) {
105        String timestamp = LocalDateTime.now().toString();
106
107        if ("Recording".equals(scope)) {
108            RecordingEntry re = recordingEntries.get(currentIndex);
109            writeOrUpdate(re.getExperimentName(), re.getRecordingName(), params, timestamp);
110            updateMemory(re, params);
111            return;
112        }
113
114        if ("Experiment".equals(scope)) {
115            String experiment = recordingEntries.get(currentIndex).getExperimentName();
116
117            for (RecordingEntry re : recordingEntries) {
118                if (re.getExperimentName().equals(experiment)) {
119                    writeOrUpdate(re.getExperimentName(), re.getRecordingName(), params, timestamp);
120                    updateMemory(re, params);
121                }
122            }
123            return;
124        }
125
126        if ("Project".equals(scope)) {
127            for (RecordingEntry re : recordingEntries) {
128                writeOrUpdate(re.getExperimentName(), re.getRecordingName(), params, timestamp);
129                updateMemory(re, params);
130            }
131        }
132    }
133
134    // ====================================================================================
135    // WRITE / UPDATE LOGIC
136    // ====================================================================================
137
138    /**
139     * Writes a new override entry or updates an existing one for the given recording.
140     * All other entries are preserved unchanged.
141     *
142     * @param experimentName experiment identifier
143     * @param recordingName  recording identifier
144     * @param params         threshold values to store
145     * @param timestamp      ISO timestamp representing when the override was written
146     */
147    private void writeOrUpdate(
148            String experimentName,
149            String recordingName,
150            SquareControlParams params,
151            String timestamp
152    ) {
153        Map<String, String> map = loadExistingRows();
154
155        String line =
156                experimentName + "," +
157                        recordingName  + "," +
158                        timestamp      + "," +
159                        params.minRequiredDensityRatio + "," +
160                        params.maxAllowableVariability + "," +
161                        params.minRequiredRSquared     + "," +
162                        params.neighbourMode;
163
164        map.put(key(experimentName, recordingName), line);
165        writeAll(map);
166    }
167
168    // ====================================================================================
169    // READ CSV INTO MAP
170    // ====================================================================================
171
172    /**
173     * Loads the existing override rows from disk and returns them as a map keyed by
174     * {@code experimentName§recordingName}.
175     * <p>
176     * If the CSV does not exist, an empty map is returned.
177     * If the header is not exactly as expected, the file is treated as invalid and
178     * ignored (empty map returned), so the next write recreates it.
179     *
180     * @return map of {@code compositeKey → CSV row}
181     */
182    private Map<String, String> loadExistingRows() {
183        Map<String, String> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
184
185        if (!Files.exists(csvFilePath)) {
186            return map;
187        }
188
189        try {
190            List<String> lines = TextFiles.readAllLines(csvFilePath);
191            if (lines.isEmpty()) return map;
192
193            String expectedHeader = String.join(",", HEADER);
194
195            // Header is invalid → ignore file and rebuild on next write.
196            if (!lines.get(0).equalsIgnoreCase(expectedHeader)) {
197                PaintLogger.warnf("Invalid Recording Override.csv header. Rebuilding.");
198                return map;
199            }
200
201            // Parse entries (store full line, indexed by composite key).
202            for (int i = 1; i < lines.size(); i++) {
203                String line = lines.get(i).trim();
204                if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
205
206                String[] parts = line.split(",", 3);
207                if (parts.length < 2) continue;
208
209                String exp = parts[0];
210                String rec = parts[1];
211
212                map.put(key(exp, rec), line);
213            }
214
215        } catch (IOException ex) {
216            PaintLogger.errorf("Failed reading Recording Override.csv: %s", ex.getMessage());
217        }
218
219        return map;
220    }
221
222    // ====================================================================================
223    // WRITE ALL ROWS (ATOMIC)
224    // ====================================================================================
225
226    /**
227     * Writes all override entries back to disk using a temporary file and replace/move.
228     * <p>
229     * This reduces the risk of leaving a truncated CSV if the process is interrupted.
230     *
231     * @param map map of {@code compositeKey → CSV row}
232     */
233    private void writeAll(Map<String, String> map) {
234        String header = String.join(",", HEADER);
235
236        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
237        out.add(header);
238        out.addAll(map.values());
239
240        Path tmp = csvFilePath.resolveSibling(csvFilePath.getFileName() + ".tmp");
241
242        try {
243            Files.write(tmp, out);
244            Files.move(tmp, csvFilePath, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
245        } catch (IOException e) {
246            PaintLogger.errorf("Failed writing Recording Override.csv: %s", e.getMessage());
247        }
248    }
249
250    // ====================================================================================
251    // UPDATE IN-MEMORY RECORDING ENTRY
252    // ====================================================================================
253
254    /**
255     * Updates the in-memory {@link paint.shared.objects.Recording} referenced by the
256     * provided {@link RecordingEntry} so the UI and filtering logic immediately reflect
257     * the current override values.
258     *
259     * @param re     recording entry to update
260     * @param params source threshold values (typically from the UI)
261     */
262    private void updateMemory(RecordingEntry re, SquareControlParams params) {
263        re.getRecording().setMinRequiredDensityRatio(params.minRequiredDensityRatio);
264        re.getRecording().setMaxAllowableVariability(params.maxAllowableVariability);
265        re.getRecording().setMinRequiredRSquared(params.minRequiredRSquared);
266        re.getRecording().setNeighbourMode(params.neighbourMode);
267    }
268}
